brand_identity.theme_description: Dark, tactical military radio rack & pro audio comms console. Blends military comms hardware (tactical keycaps, dark olive anodized aluminum plates, LCD telemetry, LED signal meters) with pro audio mixing interfaces.
anti_patterns: DO NOT re-introduce any radar, sonar, or circular map sweep visual
No generic centered card layouts or plain light forms
No transparent dropdown/modal overlays without solid/glass backgrounds
No missing data-testid attributes on interactive elements

scale.page_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-display
scale.section_header: text-lg sm:text-xl font-extrabold tracking-wide font-display text-amber_soft
scale.overline: text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-mono text-lime_soft
scale.lcd_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-wider font-mono text-lime_soft

layout_architecture.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-10

header_hero.title: Radio de Proximidad
header_hero.subtitle: Canal de voz espacial en tiempo real · The Isle: Evrima LATAM

left_transceiver_panel.lcd_display_deck: Dark olive anodized bevel container containing frequency status, live status (EN LÍNEA / FUERA DE LÍNEA), range in meters, active speakers count, and precision multi-segment LED VU meter
left_transceiver_panel.mic_mode_deck: Tactical dual selector (Pulsar para hablar vs Micrófono abierto) with keycap indicator
left_transceiver_panel.ptt_key_binding_row: Interactive key binding selector chips (Espacio, V, T, C)
left_transceiver_panel.master_ptt_keycap_button: Heavyweight military grade PTT keycap trigger button with hold state animations and glowing border
left_transceiver_panel.master_volume_dock: Master output Gain Fader / Slider + (-/+) step adjustment buttons + 'Silenciar a todos' emergency switch
left_transceiver_panel.spatial_dials_deck: Dual rotary precision dials for 'Nitidez' (spatial falloff exponent) and 'Alcance' (hearing distance in meters)

right_spatial_roster.header_bar: Roster telemetry header showing active transmitters in spatial range vs out-of-range signal count
right_spatial_roster.in_range_section: Interactive channel cards for each nearby player with signal strength meter, speaker icon with pulse effect when talking, dino species & live distance, per-player volume slider, and per-player mute toggle
right_spatial_roster.out_of_range_section: Dimmed telemetry rows for players beyond hearing radius showing distance and out-of-reach status
right_spatial_roster.empty_states: Tactical placeholder for offline state and empty in-range state with helpful adjustment hints

visual_enhancements: Textured tactical plates with bevel borders and inner glow
Anodized aluminum bevel cuts on key panels
Dynamic LED VU meter with peak amber/crimson segments
Micro-animations on speak state (pinging gold rings and active channel highlight)
Custom styled volume sliders with olive/gold accent thumbs
Tactical keycap styling for PTT button with active press down state
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Must preserve all logic, state, and hooks (useProximitySim, useMicLevel, useSound)
Must preserve all exact data-testid attributes
Do not import or render any radar or sonar visual component
Ensure all contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards over dark panels
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance and list transitions
